title: Kanban board draws only the declared lanes, in their order: ObjectKanban reads kanban.lanes
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the renderer half of #28018, whose contract half lands in PR #28196 (claim 6526161926 and amendment 6526184775 name this follow-up; contract review 6528382115 PASS). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any kanban whose view filters out a status. HotCRM's task board filters out completed tasks but still draws an always-empty `Completed` lane, and its author cannot reorder lanes, until the console reads the key.

## Observed (once PR #28196 is on `main`)

- `KanbanConfigSchema.lanes` (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) is declared: an ordered list of the group field's stored option values. Lint refuses a non-option lane (`list-view-kanban-lane-unknown`) and a repeat (`list-view-kanban-lane-repeated`) at validate, build and the publish door.
- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx` `effectiveColumns` (≈L1453–1482) still builds one lane per explicit column or per option and reads no lane list, so the key draws nothing. The `liveness/view.json` `kanban` row names `lanes` at planned strength.

## Wanted

- `effectiveColumns` filters and orders its lane list by `kanban.lanes` when set. A record whose value is not listed lands in the existing `Uncategorized` lane (≈L1819–1873), never hidden. Test plus ablation.
- The liveness note moves `lanes` from planned to live in the same PR, with the reader as evidence.
- Riders named by the contract review 6528382115 (should-fix, non-blocking): **S1** an author of `lanes` gets no "declared, not yet drawn" word today, because the blanket `kanban` row cannot carry `authorWarn`. Flipping the row to live here closes it. **S2** a one-line note in the `checkKanbanLanes` module docblock that any future widening of inline options must join its option map.

Dedupe words: kanban lanes renderer, effectiveColumns lanes, hide empty kanban lane, kanban lane order.

Links back: #28018, PR #28196.
